about: Predsolone (prednisolone 10 mg a day) is supplied every month for ten months, by brand name only, and no bisphosphonate, vitamin D or calcium is ever supplied.
Two 60-tablet prednisolone supplies cover 120 consecutive days. Fosamax Plus supplies a bisphosphonate and vitamin D. The only calcium is an antacid used when needed for heartburn.
Prednisolone is supplied only once, as a five-day course in May 2026, so the steroid is not long-term and no bone protection is expected.
